# Dataset card: synthetic datacenter telemetry (Tier 2, 48 h)

**Synthetic.** No production telemetry is used. Generated by `data/synthetic/generator/generate_tier2.py` (seed 42).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Length / rate | 17,280 steps, one every 10 s (48 h) |
| Temperature channels (D = 8) | Inlet_Temp, CPU1_Temp, CPU2_Temp, DIMM_A1_Temp, DIMM_B1_Temp, PCH_Temp, Exhaust_Temp, Fan1_norm |
| Power channels (D = 3) | PS1_Input_W, PS2_Input_W, PS1_Output_W |
| Labels | binary per step; 2,010 positive steps (11.63%) |
| Fault events | 72 (60 clean bursts, 6 overlapping bursts, 6 gradual drifts); start/end in `tier2_metadata.json` |
| Physics constants | thermal tau = 3 steps; diurnal amplitude 8 C; CRAC 1.5 C / 600 s; batch period 1,800 s; fan lag 9 steps |

## Files and checksums
See `data/synthetic/SHA256SUMS`. The three `.npy` hashes are also recorded in `results/manifests/run_manifest_v1_9.json`.
`tier2_anomaly_meta.npy` is a pickled object array (requires `allow_pickle=True`); the same events are in the JSON.

## Intended use and limits
Controlled evaluation of explanation scheduling. A single realisation of the generator; faults are injected by
construction, so results do not establish performance on production telemetry. The feature-count scaling study tiles
the 8 base temperature channels (with 1e-3 Gaussian noise) at run time; those scaled streams are not stored.

## Public datasets
SMD (MIT) and PSM (CC BY 4.0) are not redistributed here; see `data/public/README.md`.
